preconditions: The coordinator must transfer the sole runtime lease before any product, fixture, test, compiler, build, browser or native execution.
Verify pinned dependencies and generated declaration identities. Bind them read-only into a disposable candidate. Never copy node_modules or use an active sibling as source.

The qualifier must separately build and prove a cleared descendant launcher using dummy fixtures. Every Bun invocation and descendant must reject missing --no-env-file or --no-install, environment-file loading, implicit installation and escape from the pinned executable/PATH policy.
proved-bin is a qualification prerequisite, not an existing safe driver. It does not exist in this authored return. No product launcher was created or executed here.
Create empty scratch HOME and TMPDIR, close stdin, capture complete stdout/stderr, exit status and timeout. No existing unsafe inherited driver is authorized.
Run each negative alone after a positive native compile. Capture its exact file, line and diagnostic code. Preserve its source. Then prove a fresh restored candidate compiles.

Each control needs its own baseline compile and named pass, zero-fuzz/zero-offset application, successful mutant compile, named red, exact byte/mode restored candidate, restored compile and named pass.
Source inclusion requires both native listFilesOnly outputs and the complete required file set. Neither a scoped compile nor a missing inclusion pass substitutes for whole-source compilation.
Both consumer processes must finish with exit 0. Compare both complete byte streams to the independent expected.jsonl through EOF.
Reconcile any later owner-services qualification repairs against this frozen input before acceptance.
